newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TNT to boost Dutch PTT Post revenues.
newsitem.headline: TNT to boost Dutch PTT Post revenues.

text.p: Dutch telecommunications and post group Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (KPN) will significantly boost revenues from its PTT Post division following Wednesday's 2.7 billion guilder bid for TNT Ltd of Australia.
Below is an outline of the Dutch company's current structure and proforma changes once the recommended acquisition goes through to completion.
* Dutch PTT 1995 group net income 2.26 billion guilders.
* 1995 total operating revenues 19.86 billion guilders. PTT Post generated 6.08 billion of sales, PTT Telecom 13.62 billion and other activities 1.56 billion.
* 1995 operating income of 3.94 billion was split 721 million for Post, 3.18 billion for Telecom and 37 million for KPN other.
* KPN says business segments in terms of sales 68 percent Telecom, 31 percent Post and one percent other.
* On a pro-forma basis of 27 billion guilders of annual sales following TNT acquisition this will change to 51 percent Telecom, 48 percent Post and one percent other.
* PTT Post currently generates five billion guilders of annual revenue from Netherlands and one billion from rest of world.
* After TNT acquisition this will change to six billion from Netherlands and seven billion from rest of world.
* Following acquisition contributions from growth markets to PTT Post revenues will rise to 75 percent from 45 percent. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
